scripts/check-contribution-derivation.mjs deriveContributions() at ourRetailCad 84.99 / itemCostCad 47.38 / supplierShipCad 0 / dutyRate 0.07 -> CA$19.83 (RULE 26).
costSource: AliExpress Canadian-gateway per-SKU price from window._d_c_ PRICE.skuPriceInfoMap on listing 1005008081008680, SKU 200000531:193#30CM;200007763:201336100;136:200003939#No Bulb. The page SELLS at C$29.57 against an originalPrice of C$47.38 - a 38% promotion. RULE 22 makes the LIST price the cost basis, so itemCostCad is 47.38 and NOT 29.57. This is the same test that put the sconce on COST_HOLD (52% off a C$78.14 list, negative at the list cost): the difference here is that the offer SURVIVES at list - CA$19.83 against the CA$16.23 floor at CA$84.99 - so the promotion is upside, not the margin. If the sale price is what DSers actually charges on an order, contribution is about CA$36; nothing here depends on that. Not yet cross-checked against a DSers stable cost: the product does not exist in Shopify or DSers yet.
dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The deeper difference from the US is the BASE: this 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price, where the US charges its 41.4% (HTS 9405.11.80) on retail. About CA$2.04 a unit against US$40.57.
verdict: Priced at CA$84.99, CA$1.74 under the CA$86.73 RULE 2 ceiling (median CA$75.42 x 1.15). Contributes CA$19.83/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) at the LIST cost of C$47.38, against the CA$16.23 floor - clears by CA$3.60, the thinnest offer in the Canadian catalogue. At the C$29.57 sale price it would contribute about CA$36, but rule 22 forbids pricing on a promotion. Per-SKU stock 45 clears rule 4 (>= 25); the DE/PL ship-from siblings at 48 / 53 are NOT this SKU and must not be added to it. Top competitor review count 255 in this basket, so the category is not locked. CAUTION: 12 sold on the listing, the thinnest social proof in the range, and the margin is thin at list - if the list price moves up by more than about C$3.90 this offer falls under the floor and comes off.
supplierSkuUnitCapMethod: Read as skuStock from window._d_c_ lifeCycleEventList[0].data.SKU.skuPaths[] on listing 1005008081008680, joined per-variant to PRICE.skuPriceInfoMap. Per-SKU for the China-mainland ship-from path only; the same 30CM shade ships from DE (48) and PL (53) as separate SKUs and those are not counted. Not clamp-tested via the quantity box.
retailNote: Priced 2026-09-13 at CA$84.99, NOT the CA$74.99 the other four pendants carry, and the reason is arithmetic rather than positioning: at CA$74.99 deriveContributions files CA$11.18 at the C$47.38 list cost, which is CA$5.05 BELOW the CA$16.23 floor, so the offer cannot exist at the shared price. CA$84.99 is the highest whole-dollar-99 price under the CA$86.73 ceiling and files CA$19.83. Two things follow. It is the largest piece in the range (30 x 30 cm, three tiers) so the price sits where the size does. And it is the first Canadian offer priced near the ceiling rather than the median, which the 2026-09-13 reprice note argued against for a store with no reviews - accepted here because the alternative is not listing it, and because the promotion, if it holds on the order, makes the realised margin comfortable.
